title: DC fusion center FOIA on psychotronic effects

tellings.quote: there was a FOIA leak out of the Washington D.C. fusion center that someone had filed a FOIA with regards to looking into some uh political groups, but it turned out that they were given I think the file was called uh effects on the human body.

plain: A Washington, D.C. fusion center, a hub where federal and local agencies share intelligence, is said to have released a file on how certain technologies affect people's bodies and minds. The researcher Dave Rossi tells it without naming a source. As he describes it, someone used FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask about some political groups, and what came back included a file he thinks was called "effects on the human body." Rossi calls this a leak and offers it as a sign that the government has looked into such effects.
